Zalazane's Malice.why: Sidekick's generated Voodoo rotation prose says 'keep Zalazane's Malice applied ... spread by Bad Juju/Hexfire', treating it as the DoT. The thing actually applied, spread and maintained is Hex of Malice (801693), which is the id a WeakAura can track.
